source: Independent Thread Scheduling, introduced on Volta-generation ZXNAME0000XZ GPUs, makes thread scheduling more flexible than older lockstep implementations. It does not make arbitrary divergence free, nor does it remove the need to use the synchronization primitives required by ZXNAME0001XZ’s programming model.[1]
zh: Volta 一代 ZXNAME0000XZ GPU 上引入的独立线程调度使线程调度比旧的锁步实现更加灵活。它不会消除任意分歧，也不会消除使用 ZXNAME0001XZ 编程模型所需的同步原语的需要。 [1]
